💡 Suggested Deck Additions

Data-driven picks that would help against multiple opponents tomorrow and aren't already in your current 7 sets.

Archer Queen / Royal Hogs cycle
Top predicted counter (67-100% win rate) for 5 of your 7 opponents -- Adox, RAD, Lucas✨杰克, SandBox, BenZer. You don't currently have an Archer Queen deck at all. Single strongest addition available.
Mortar / Rascals bait toolbox
Top predicted counter (67-100%) for 3 of your 7 opponents -- Lucas.xit (both #1 and #2 slots), Lucas✨杰克 (#1 and #5), DK. A stronger refinement of the Mortar concept you already lean on.
Balloon / Miner control
Top predicted counter (67-75%) for 3 of your 7 opponents -- Adox, DK, BenZer. Also helps diversify you off Hog Rider, your single most over-repeated win-con (see Pattern Warning below).

⚠ Pattern-Detection Warning

All 7 opponents are in your own round-robin group -- anyone who's compared notes with an earlier opponent could be scouting a pattern by the back half of your day.

#1 -- Hog Rider (6 of 7 sets)
Every opponent except SandBox has a Hog Rider option in your prep (DK, Lucas✨杰克, RAD, Adox, Lucas.xit, BenZer). Your single biggest exposure -- if you play it more than once, especially early, later opponents have every reason to expect it.
What the data says beats it:
Goblin Drill cycle
65% win rate vs Hog Rider, 251-game sample
Golem / Lava Hound beatdown
also does well vs Hog Rider pools
#2 -- Evo Wall Breakers chassis (4 of 7 sets)
DK (D2), Adox (D1), Lucas.xit (D1), SandBox (D2). BenZer's corrected set does NOT include this chassis, so it's slightly less universal than first thought.
What the data says beats it:
Royal Hogs

#3 -- Goblin Drill (4 of 7 sets)
DK (D1), RAD (D3), SandBox (D3), BenZer (D1) -- more repeated than it first looked once BenZer's real prep was in.
#4 -- Mortar (3 of first 4 sets)
DK, Lucas✨杰克, Adox -- all in your first 4 matches.

Practical takeaway: Hog Rider is your real exposure this time. If two decks are similarly rated for an opponent, favor holding Hog Rider back rather than opening with it, especially from opponent 3 (RAD) onward. Your Royal Hogs and Graveyard/Mortar decks are comparatively under-used and give you a way to break the pattern.
